units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 36:18">Targ. Jer. XXXVI, 18</cite>.—
<cite ref="Niddah 20a:17">Nidd. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>פכחותא דד׳</he> the watery part of the ink, <he>חרותא דד׳</he> the sediment.
Ib. קורטא דד׳ a piece of dry ink (a sort of Indian ink, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Atramentum).—Denom. דַּיֵּית to dot with inkmarks.
